milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The oak_wall_sign is placed at spawn-relative (4, 1, 3) on the front wall of the building facing south. The player must navigate near it and face toward it to 'find' it. max_distance=16 allows the player to see it from a reasonable distance outside the building, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are actually looking at the sign.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The iron door is placed at spawn-relative (8, 1, 7) on the internal dividing wall inside the building. The player must enter the building through the front entrance and navigate toward the iron door. max_distance=16 allows seeing it from within the building corridor, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the door.

Uses inventory_has because mining a polished_granite_slab drops the item into the player's inventory. The polished granite slabs cover the floor of the back room behind the iron door (spawn-relative x=9-12, y=0, z=5-9). The player needs to break at least one slab and pick up the drop. inventory_has is the preferred rule for mine tasks since the mined item ends up in inventory.
